data.title: If You Put $1,000 Each Into Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP and Solana Five Years Ago, Two Would Have Lost Money.
data.description: Four popular cryptocurrencies, one $4,000 total investment, and a five-year window that produced wildly different results. The coins that generated the most excitement heading into late 2021 may not be the ones that rewarded investors most.
